name: cum-trend-populated
note: cum_trend crosses the same trust boundary as trends via the shared normalize function: a populated sparkline survives verbatim, and a row carrying an OSC-52 clipboard-write control sequence + BEL comes back with its control characters replaced. Also covers cum_trend_axis riding alongside a populated cum_trend, normalizing to whatever 8-tick list the daemon sends -- now autoscaled to the window's own observed peak rather than a fixed ceiling, so these exact values are illustrative, not pinned to a constant.
